name: MCboard
description: Plans a circuit placed on an MCboard working copy: which chevrons to close and which wires to add, puts the plan into the copper for the ratsnest, and updates the ratsnest while wiring by hand.

actions.name: MCboard nets
actions.description: For wiring by hand: update the nets after drawing chevrons and wires, so the ratsnest shows only the connections still missing

actions.name: MCboard plan
actions.description: Work out which chevrons to close and which wires to add for the placed parts

actions.name: MCboard apply
actions.description: Put the plan into the copper: schematic nets on the strips, tracks for closed chevrons and wires

actions.name: MCboard clear
actions.description: Take the board back to before planning and applying: remove the applied tracks and the plan marks, give the strips their own nets
